newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-ARSENAL'S VIEIRA IN FRANCE SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ARSENAL'S VIEIRA IN FRANCE SQUAD.

text.p: France coach Aime Jacquet called up Arsenal midfielder Patrick Vieira for the first time when he named his squad on Thursday for the home friendly against the Netherlands next Wednesday.

Jacquet omitted Internazionale forward Youri Djorkaeff for the first time since May 1996. Having been given the choice by Jacquet, Djorkaeff opted to play for his club in the return leg of their Italian Cup semifinal at Napoli on the same night.
France's Euro 96 goalkeeper Bernard Lama returned to the squad for the first time since a knee injury in September.
Bordeaux's exciting midfielder Ibrahim Ba, who scored on his debut in the 2-0 away win over Portugal last month, retained his place.

Another Italian exile, former Guingamp defender Vincent Candela, was recalled along with Athletic Bilbao left back Bixente Lizarazu, another member of Jacquet's Euro 96 squad, who last played for France against Mexico in August.
Goalkeepers - Fabien Barthez (Monaco), Bernard Lama (Paris St Germain)
Defenders - Laurent Blanc (Barcelone), Marcel Desailly (AC Milan), Vincent Candela (AS Roma), Bixente Lizarazu (Athletic Bilbao), Patrick Blondeau (Monaco), Lilian Thuram (Parma)
Midfielders - Didier Deschamps (Juventus), Christian Karembeu, Pierre Laigle (both Sampdoria), Bruno N'Gotty (PSG), Patrick Vieira (Arsenal).
Forwards - Zinedine Zidane (Juventus), Ibrahim Ba (Bordeaux), Christophe Dugarry (AC Milan), Patrice Loko (PSG), Robert Pires (Metz).
